title: Brazilian Sweet Potato Bisque
description: A rich and creamy soup made with roasted sweet potatoes, earthy flavors, and a hint of velvety texture.
instructions: Roast sweet potatoes for 30 minutes, or until tender.
Sauté onion and garlic in butter until softened.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid.
Add roasted sweet potatoes, spice blend, and vegetable broth.
Puree soup in blender until smooth.
Return soup to pot and simmer for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped herbs if desired.
